ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an organic transition-state structure, containing several curved arrows; the problem asks to ignore these arrows. Looking only at the molecular skeleton, the left end is an R substituent connected to an alkene fragment, and the alkene continues to connect to the chiral carbon on the right. This chiral carbon is also connected to an R1 substituent, an implicit hydrogen, and an upward oxygen atom; the oxygen is then connected to an imidoyl/trichloromethyl fragment, with CCl3 at the top and HN on the left. Reasoning: According to the specified method, write the left-end R as the wildcard atom '*', and record the alkene as */C=C/ in the E-style slash notation shown in the figure. After the alkene is connected to the adjacent chiral carbon, the chiral carbon bears the R1 wildcard substituent and is written as [C@H](*). Then go from this carbon along the bond to oxygen, and then to the OC(=N)C(Cl)(Cl)Cl fragment. Concatenating these parts gives the SMILES: */C=C/[C@H](*)OC(=N)C(Cl)(Cl)Cl.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First visually isolate only the molecular framework, ignoring the curved arrows. Translate the left substituent R as '*' attached to an alkene, write the alkene with the depicted E-style slash notation as */C=C/, then continue to the adjacent stereogenic carbon as [C@H](*) where the parenthesized '*' is the R1 substituent. From that carbon follow the bond to oxygen and then to the imidoyl/trichloromethyl fragment, giving OC(=N)C(Cl)(Cl)Cl. Concatenate these pieces to obtain */C=C/[C@H](*)OC(=N)C(Cl)(Cl)Cl.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个有机过渡态结构，含有若干弯曲箭头；题目要求忽略这些箭头。只看分子骨架，左端是 R 取代基连接到一个烯烃片段，烯烃继续连接到右侧的手性碳。该手性碳还连接 R1 取代基、一个隐含氢以及向上的氧原子；氧再连接到一个亚胺酰/三氯甲基片段，顶部为 CCl3，左侧为 HN。推理：按照指定方法，将左端 R 写作通配原子 '*'，烯烃按图示 E-style 斜杠记为 */C=C/。烯烃后接相邻手性碳，手性碳带 R1 通配取代基，写作 [C@H](*)。随后从该碳沿键到氧，再到 OC(=N)C(Cl)(Cl)Cl 片段。将这些部分串联，得到 SMILES：*/C=C/[C@H](*)OC(=N)C(Cl)(Cl)Cl。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct structure-to-SMILES transcription from the displayed connectivity and stereochemical drawing; no alternate inference source is needed, so this is the single honest route.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the drawn skeleton after disregarding the curved arrows: an R-substituted alkene connected to a stereogenic carbon bearing R1, H, and O; the O is bonded to an imidoyl carbon C(=N/H) that is also bonded to CCl3. Note the alkene geometry shown by the slanted bonds and the stereochemical wedge at the chiral carbon.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the required output is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent unspecified R/R1 groups as wildcard atoms '*'; encode the alkene geometry with /C=C/; encode the tetrahedral stereocenter as [C@H]; encode the imidate fragment as OC(=N)C(Cl)(Cl)Cl; omit all curved-arrow transition-state electron-flow annotations.
